subject: Banking
title: What Banking Looks Like in 2035
description: A 60-second lesson on What Banking Looks Like in 2035.

hook.text: By 2035, your bank may have no name you recognize. It will live inside your phone, your car, your employer.

buildup.text: Open banking, AI, and embedded finance are converging. Every service will have financial features built in seamlessly.

discovery.text: Your phone will auto-negotiate loan rates, switch savings accounts for better yield.

twist.text: Traditional banks will not disappear. They will become invisible infrastructure like power grids. Essential but unseen.

climax.text: The future of banking is not a better bank. It is banking without knowing you are banking. Finance becomes ambient.

punchline.text: Banking without a bank. Finance becomes invisible infrastructure.

quiz.question: What does the concept of 'ambient finance' mean?
options: Financial services seamlessly embedded into daily activities without user awareness

details.summary: By 2035, banking is projected to be largely invisible, AI-driven, and embedded into daily life. Physical branches will be rare, most lending decisions will be automated, and financial services will be personalized to individual behavior patterns.
details.whyItMatters: The banking industry is in the middle of its most significant transformation since the invention of the ATM. How it evolves will determine who controls the financial lives of billions of people for the next generation.
takeaways: AI will handle most customer interactions and lending decisions
Banking services will be embedded into non-financial platforms
Physical branches will shrink to advisory-only locations in major cities

faq.question: Will traditional banks still exist in 2035?
faq.answer: Most will, but in radically different form. Large banks will become technology platforms, mid-size banks will specialize in niches, and small banks will either merge or become community advisory centers. The banking license remains valuable.

faq.question: What skills will bank employees need in 2035?
faq.answer: Technology expertise, data science, AI management, and complex relationship advisory. Routine tasks will be fully automated. Human bankers will focus on high-value advisory, complex problem solving, and situations requiring empathy and judgment.
